title: Path Queries
statementMd:
You are given a weighted tree consisting of $n$ vertices. Recall that a tree is a connected graph without cycles. Vertices $u_i$ and $v_i$ are connected by an edge with weight $w_i$.

You are given $m$ queries. The $i$-th query is given as an integer $q_i$. In this query you need to calculate the number of pairs of vertices $(u, v)$ ($u \lt v$) such that the maximum weight of an edge on a simple path between $u$ and $v$ doesn't exceed $q_i$.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $n$ and $m$ ($1 \le n, m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$) — the number of vertices in the tree and the number of queries.

Each of the next $n - 1$ lines describes an edge of the tree. Edge $i$ is denoted by three integers $u_i$, $v_i$ and $w_i$ — the labels of vertices it connects ($1 \le u_i, v_i \le n$, $u_i \ne v_i$) and the weight of the edge ($1 \le w_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$). It is guaranteed that the given edges form a tree.

The last line of the input contains $m$ integers $q_1, q_2, \dots, q_m$ ($1 \le q_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$), where $q_i$ is the maximum weight of an edge in the $i$-th query.

## Output

Print $m$ integers — the answers to the queries. The $i$-th value should be equal to the number of pairs of vertices $(u, v)$ ($u \lt v$) such that the maximum weight of an edge on a simple path between $u$ and $v$ doesn't exceed $q_i$.

**Queries are numbered from $1$ to $m$ in the order of the input**.

## Note

The picture shows the tree from the first example: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/72719dd3f66b3e69a28d5278fedfe14cca697350.png)
statementZhMd:
给定一棵由 $n$ 个顶点组成的带权树。回忆一下，树是一个无环的连通图。顶点 $u_i$ 和 $v_i$ 之间有一条权重为 $w_i$ 的边。

给定 $m$ 个查询。第 $i$ 个查询给出一个整数 $q_i$。对于该查询，你需要计算满足以下条件的顶点对 $(u, v)$（$u \lt v$）的数量：从 $u$ 到 $v$ 的简单路径上，边的最大权重不超过 $q_i$。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $m$（$1 \le n, m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$）——树中顶点的数量和查询的数量。

接下来的 $n - 1$ 行每行描述树的一条边。第 $i$ 条边由三个整数 $u_i$、$v_i$ 和 $w_i$ 表示——它连接的顶点编号（$1 \le u_i, v_i \le n$，$u_i \ne v_i$）以及边的权重（$1 \le w_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$）。保证给出的边构成一棵树。

输入的最后一行包含 $m$ 个整数 $q_1, q_2, \dots, q_m$（$1 \le q_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$），其中 $q_i$ 是第 $i$ 个查询中允许的边的最大权重。

## 输出格式

输出 $m$ 个整数——各个查询的答案。第 $i$ 个数应等于满足以下条件的顶点对 $(u, v)$（$u \lt v$）的数量：从 $u$ 到 $v$ 的简单路径上，边的最大权重不超过 $q_i$。

**查询按照输入中的顺序从 $1$ 到 $m$ 编号。**
